items.headline: Deion Sanders: Comment about silencing critics with money was a joke
items.description: Deion Sanders said Tuesday that comments from a person close to him who suggested the Colorado coach was willing to pay $50,000 to silence his critics was merely a joke.

items.headline: Oklahoma State scores 34 points in the 2nd half to storm past Colorado 57-24
items.description: — Drew Mestemaker threw for 386 yards and four touchdowns, Sam Keltner kicked a school-record five field goals, and Oklahoma State held Colorado to 120 yards of offense in the second half of a 57-24 win on Saturday night.
